name: Crémant de Limoux

limits: Chardonnay and Chenin Blanc together: at most 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
A white or rosé traditional-method sparkling wine from one of France's crémant appellations, made from hand-picked grapes and aged at least nine months on its lees.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for quality sparkling wine in which Chardonnay is the main grape.
